source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The owned local and IMAP tests check stored name, localizedName and database folderName separately, but eleven changed localizedName assertions have no message. A scoped review repair should name the folder case and expected representation, with should in each authored message. Keep these independent assertions: a correct translated display label does not prove the stored/server name or database metadata stayed unchanged. This is a test-diagnostic finding and proposed local repair under the deliberate assertion instructions, not a claim that the historical tests already follow that rule.
title: Folder-name assertion messages need to identify the expected representation
